title: Prevalence of and Enforcement against Jaywalking
what_it_is: Prevalence of and Enforcement against Jaywalking

sections.label: Jaywalking violations and fatal accidents
sections.summary: In 2019 TP detected about 2,500 jaywalking violations, and from 2017 to 2019 there were 59 fatal accidents involving jaywalkers, about 68% elderly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2019, the Traffic Police (TP) detected about 2,500 jaywalking violations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 2017 to 2019, there were 59 fatal traffic accidents involving jaywalkers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Elderly jaywalkers were involved in about 68% of them.

sections.label: Silver Zones increase plan
sections.summary: LTA plans to increase the number of Silver Zones from 17 in 2019 to 50 by 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: LTA plans to increase the number of Silver Zones from 17 in 2019 to 50 by 2023.

sections.label: Composition sum raised
sections.summary: The composition sum for this offence was raised from $20 to $50 on 1 April 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The composition sum for this offence was raised from $20 to $50 on 1 April 2019.

sections.label: Enforcement and technology question
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry will step up enforcement and use technology such as CCTV and facial recognition, especially at locations with fatal accidents.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry step up enforcement and whether it will use technology, for example, closed-circuit television (CCTV), facial recognition, especially at those locations that have had fatal accidents?

sections.label: TP response on enforcement technology
sections.summary: TP would intensify operations when there is feedback about jaywalking hotspots, and there is feedback that facial recognition technology can be quite invasive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When there is feedback about jaywalking hotspots, TP would intensify their operations as and when they hear feedback from the ground regarding this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the use of CCTV and technological means, for these to be effective, as the Member mentioned, there needs to be the use of facial recognition technology.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There is some feedback from the ground that the use of such technology can be quite invasive.
